metadata.description: Mawica STAGING workload, deployed only with the owner's approval (infra/staging/app.sh). On top of main.json and registry.json (all images pulled from the private ACR by the app's managed identity, by digest): least-privilege database credentials in Key Vault; three identities (web app, role job, migration job), each reading only its own secrets (secret-scoped Key Vault Secrets User) and pulling from ACR (AcrPull); a role-bootstrap job and a migration job (Container Apps jobs inside the VNet, manual trigger), the web container app (scale 0-1, HTTPS ingress, health probes, Key Vault secrets via managed identity, email and scheduled delivery off), and GitHub Actions' minimum permissions (update the app and the migration job only).
base64 of infra/staging/sql/azure-pg-roots.crt (public root CAs; the postgres image has no CA bundle). Used for sslmode=verify-full.
New password for mawica_app. Empty: keep the current Key Vault secrets (no rotation).
false until roles and migrations have run.

Public https origin of the web app (NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL and BETTER_AUTH_URL at runtime). Empty: the Azure-generated https://ca-mawica-stg.<environment default domain>. Must match the URL the image was built with (STAGING_URL).

Comma-separated EXTRA https origins allowed to call auth and write APIs (AUTH_TRUSTED_ORIGINS), e.g. the Azure hostname during a domain cutover. Empty: only siteUrl. Never '*': entries are parsed as URLs and anything else is ignored by the app; app.sh refuses non-https or wildcard values.

Custom hostname bound to the web app (e.g. staging.mawica.com). Empty: no custom domain. app.sh passes the LIVE binding automatically, because a full deployment replaces the ingress and would otherwise remove it.
Resource ID of the certificate for customDomainName (an environment managedCertificates/... or certificates/... resource). Required when customDomainName is set.
EMAIL_PROVIDER for the web app. resend also wires RESEND_API_KEY and EMAIL_RECIPIENT_ALLOWLIST from Key Vault (secrets resend-api-key, email-recipient-allowlist).
EMAIL_FROM_AUTH: plain sender address on a Resend-verified domain (only used with emailProvider=resend).
MAWICA_EMAIL_ALLOWLIST_REQUIRED (only used with emailProvider=resend). Staging keeps 1: no allowlist = no email.
MAWICA_DISABLE_EXTERNAL_EMAIL kill switch. 1 = no external email whatever the provider settings.
false: identities, ACR pulls and Key Vault grants only (bootstrap; see app.sh identities / roles).

Names of secrets that already exist in the vault (app.sh reads them, names only). Secret-scoped grants are made only for these and for secrets this deployment creates: Azure cannot assign a role on a secret that does not exist.

containers.name: roles
command: set -e; echo "$ROLES_SQL_B64" | base64 -d > /tmp/roles.sql; echo "$PG_ROOT_CAS_B64" | base64 -d > /tmp/roots.pem; TLS='sslmode=verify-full sslrootcert=/tmp/roots.pem'; H=$(printf %s "$ADMIN_URL" | sed -E 's#^[^@]*@([^:/?]+).*#\1#'); case "$H" in *.postgres.database.azure.com) ;; *) echo 'unexpected database host'; exit 1 ;; esac; psql "$ADMIN_URL&sslmode=verify-full&sslrootcert=/tmp/roots.pem" -X -q -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -v app_password="$APP_PW" -v migrate_password="$MIGRATE_PW" -v dbname=mawica -f /tmp/roles.sql; echo ROLES_OK; PGPASSWORD="$APP_PW" psql "host=$H port=5432 dbname=mawica user=mawica_app $TLS" -X -q -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "DO \$c\$ BEGIN IF current_user <> 'mawica_app' OR current_database() <> 'mawica' OR NOT (SELECT ssl FROM pg_stat_ssl WHERE pid = pg_backend_pid()) OR NOT has_schema_privilege('public','USAGE') OR has_schema_privilege('public','CREATE') OR has_database_privilege(current_database(),'CREATE') OR (SELECT rolsuper OR rolcreatedb OR rolcreaterole OR rolreplication OR rolbypassrls FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = current_user) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'APP_CHECK failed'; END IF; END \$c\$;"; echo APP_CHECK_OK; PGPASSWORD="$MIGRATE_PW" psql "host=$H port=5432 dbname=mawica user=mawica_migrator $TLS" -X -q -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "DO \$c\$ BEGIN IF current_user <> 'mawica_migrator' OR current_database() <> 'mawica' OR NOT (SELECT ssl FROM pg_stat_ssl WHERE pid = pg_backend_pid()) OR NOT has_schema_privilege('public','CREATE') OR has_database_privilege(current_database(),'CREATE') OR (SELECT rolsuper OR rolcreatedb OR rolcreaterole OR rolreplication OR rolbypassrls FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = current_user) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'MIGRATOR_CHECK failed'; END IF; END \$c\$;"; echo MIGRATOR_CHECK_OK; rm -f /tmp/roles.sql /tmp/roots.pem; echo CHECKS_OK

configuration.ingress: [union(createObject('external', true(), 'targetPort', 8080, 'transport', 'auto', 'allowInsecure', false()), if(empty(parameters('customDomainName')), createObject(), createObject('customDomains', variables('customDomains'))))]
configuration.secrets: [concat(createArray(createObject('name', 'database-app-url', 'keyVaultUrl', variables('kvSecret').app, 'identity', variables('appId')), createObject('name', 'better-auth-secret', 'keyVaultUrl', concat(variables('kvUri'), 'better-auth-secret'), 'identity', variables('appId')), createObject('name', 'welcome-pepper', 'keyVaultUrl', concat(variables('kvUri'), 'welcome-pepper'), 'identity', variables('appId')), createObject('name', 'rate-limit-salt', 'keyVaultUrl', concat(variables('kvUri'), 'rate-limit-salt'), 'identity', variables('appId'))), if(equals(parameters('emailProvider'), 'resend'), createArray(createObject('name', 'resend-api-key', 'keyVaultUrl', concat(variables('kvUri'), 'resend-api-key'), 'identity', variables('appId')), createObject('name', 'email-recipient-allowlist', 'keyVaultUrl', concat(variables('kvUri'), 'email-recipient-allowlist'), 'identity', variables('appId'))), createArray()))]

containers.name: web
containers.env: [concat(createArray(createObject('name', 'NODE_ENV', 'value', 'production'), createObject('name', 'HOSTNAME', 'value', '0.0.0.0'), createObject('name', 'PORT', 'value', '8080'), createObject('name', 'DATABASE_URL', 'secretRef', 'database-app-url'), createObject('name', 'DATABASE_POOL_MAX', 'value', '5'), createObject('name', 'BETTER_AUTH_SECRET', 'secretRef', 'better-auth-secret'), createObject('name', 'WELCOME_PEPPER', 'secretRef', 'welcome-pepper'), createObject('name', 'RATE_LIMIT_SALT', 'secretRef', 'rate-limit-salt')), createArray(createObject('name', 'NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL', 'value', if(empty(parameters('siteUrl')), concat('https://', variables('appName'), '.', reference(resourceId('Microsoft.App/managedEnvironments', variables('envName')), '2024-03-01').defaultDomain), parameters('siteUrl'))), createObject('name', 'BETTER_AUTH_URL', 'value', if(empty(parameters('siteUrl')), concat('https://', variables('appName'), '.', reference(resourceId('Microsoft.App/managedEnvironments', variables('envName')), '2024-03-01').defaultDomain), parameters('siteUrl')))), createArray(createObject('name', 'TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS', 'value', '1'), createObject('name', 'EMAIL_PROVIDER', 'value', parameters('emailProvider')), createObject('name', 'MAWICA_DISABLE_EXTERNAL_EMAIL', 'value', parameters('disableExternalEmail')), createObject('name', 'EMAIL_DELIVERY_ENABLED', 'value', '0')), if(equals(parameters('emailProvider'), 'resend'), createArray(createObject('name', 'EMAIL_FROM_AUTH', 'value', parameters('emailFromAuth')), createObject('name', 'MAWICA_EMAIL_ALLOWLIST_REQUIRED', 'value', parameters('emailAllowlistRequired')), createObject('name', 'RESEND_API_KEY', 'secretRef', 'resend-api-key'), createObject('name', 'EMAIL_RECIPIENT_ALLOWLIST', 'secretRef', 'email-recipient-allowlist')), createArray()), if(empty(parameters('authTrustedOrigins')), createArray(), createArray(createObject('name', 'AUTH_TRUSTED_ORIGINS', 'value', parameters('authTrustedOrigins')))))]
